three escapes to the
Nordhavn line

findings.why: Galvanica Eporediese is listed only as an electroplating coater. No controlled approval record covers it for casting HB-620, for any receiving plant or for Nordhavn. Absence of a record is not proof that it is not approved, so a person must confirm. The plant is not named either.

The drawing requires MAT-ALSI9CU3 and has a porosity special characteristic. The documents contain no 3.1 material certificate for castings from Galvanica Eporediese, so a person must say whether one exists.
